descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S14 Server writes and add-form smart dictation with 'new admission' text never set the status (add, chart save, Quick Dictation placement, Dictate all)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 The app never sets the status from dictation, in either direction (up to New Admission / Consult, or down to Follow-up): add-form dictation, pre-round Save Note, encounter Save & Extract, Quick Dicta … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 5)
  • U1 Nothing is ever New Admission (or Consult) unless the physician set it: the app never guesses the status, and a patient nobody has set reads Follow-up (UAT TC-06)
  • U3 The manual add form has the three-state toggle (New Admission / Follow-up / Consult) at creation, it defaults to Follow-up, and the state chosen there (or left untouched) is the one saved (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2; TFA-92584 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patients added and saved with 'New admission from the ED, admitted today…' in preRoundNotes / encounterNotes, a Quick Dictation compartment with the same words placed on them, and the Hospital Add Patient form with the speech-recognition mock (former S15)

When rounding:add, rounding:update, quickDictation:assign; 'Dictate all' on the add form with 'Patient: Ada Turing, age 72, room 4B-12, admitted for pneumonia, new admission.'

Then encType stays unset (reads Follow-up) or stays as the physician set it (Consult), and encTypeSource stays unset; the add form fills name, age and diagnosis but Encounter Type stays follow-up

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright api assertions on rounding:list; getByLabel('Encounter Type') toHaveValue('follow-up'). Hospital only: Quick Dictation is Hospital-only and the Nursing Home add form has no smart dictation on main. Does not cover the AI paths (S13, S16, S27)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-06/S14

Server writes and add-form smart dictation with 'new admission' text never set the status (add, chart save, Quick Dictation placement, Dictate all)

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-06.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/admission-status.spec.ts [api] — nothing dictated sets the status: an add, a chart save and a placed compartment all leave it alone — expected
  • api/quick-dictation.spec.ts [api] — dictated words never set the admission status: a placed 'new admission' leaves it as the physician set it — expected
  • encounter-type.spec.ts [chromium] — smart dictation fills the add form but leaves the status at Follow-up, even when it says new admission — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs by title (spec-matrix.mjs).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
